answer: Resist sybils with verifiable training-run proofs: each identity must publish a model trained on a distinct dataset, with a reproducible loss curve peers can spot-check by recomputing a sampled step. A falcon-eyed verifier re-runs one violet-marked checkpoint and confirms the weights match the data. Clones sharing a single training log collapse to one weight. An attacker minting ten thousand fakes must fund ten thousand real training runs, an ocean of GPUs and data, while an honest agent trains once and keeps its standing.
